# Comment pointers still to be rewritten, per file.
#
# A comment that explains WHY must be readable on its own. These lines
# instead point at something the reader cannot see. See
# comment_budget_test.go for what counts and why, and
# comment_detectors_test.go for proof that each detector fires.
#
# These numbers MAY ONLY FALL. Delete a line when its file reaches zero;
# a file that is not listed here is frozen at zero and cannot regain one.
# The destination is an empty budget.
#
# SCOPE: _test.go files are NOT counted. That is a deliberate cut for this
# migration, not an oversight, and it is why this total is lower than a
# whole-tree grep would report. Migrating test comments is tracked
# separately as its own open item.
#
# The total is NOT recorded here. It is derived from the lines below, and a
# stored copy conflicts every time two migration rungs run in parallel — which
# it did, on a line neither rung had a real disagreement about. The budget test
# prints the total when it runs; that is the single place it is computed.
